name: Silk Queen
shortDescription: The next mouth after the hatchling. She waits for three.
lookDescription: A larger silk-shape fills the split cradle, unfinished and listening for more than one pair of feet.
examineDescription: The Silk Queen is bigger than the hatchling and still not finished. Longer legs. Thicker silk. Alder would not send one Collegian for this. If she squares up, lock your moves on the same clock. When she falls, she stays fallen.
